_comment: Which public URLs are indexable. Read by the site (src/lib/seoPolicy.ts), the prerender (scripts/prerender.mjs), scripts/verify-seo.mjs and the content gate (content-machine/scripts/blog_gate.py). Noindexing a page: add it to noindex with the reason. Merging: add it to merged; the prerender writes the 301. Deleting an entry undoes it.

noindex./blog/trigify-vs-gojiberry: Same outline as the other Trigify-vs posts about a product that closed on 22 October 2026; deadline-led title; the pillar and /compare/intentsly-vs-gojiberry cover the decision.
noindex./blog/trigify-vs-teamfluence: Same outline as trigify-vs-valley (19% of its wording is shared); third-party comparison of a closed product; the pillar and /compare/intentsly-vs-teamfluence cover the decision.
noindex./blog/trigify-vs-valley: Same outline as trigify-vs-teamfluence (23% of its wording is shared); written in the future tense about a closure that has happened; the pillar and /compare/intentsly-vs-valley cover the decision.
noindex./blog/rebuild-trigify-workflows-in-clay: Unique, but the title promises a rebuild before a deadline that passed on 22 October 2026. Noindexed until refreshed, not because of length.
noindex./blog/trigify-alternative-for-smartlead-: Unique, but its steps start from exporting out of Trigify before a deadline that has passed. Noindexed until refreshed, not because of length.
noindex./blog/migrate-from-trigify-to-intentsly: Unique steps, but the title promises a migration before 22 October 2026 and the intent overlaps /compare/trigify-vs-intentsly. Noindexed until refreshed.
noindex./solutions/find-leads-for-a-software-com: Template: 35% of its wording is shared with /solutions/find-customers-for-b2b-saas, which targets the same buyer.
noindex./solutions/get-clients-for-a-saas-compan: Same search intent as /solutions/find-customers-for-b2b-saas (SaaS customers). Mostly original wording, so noindexed for cannibalisation rather than quality.
noindex./solutions/find-b2b-clients-online: Template: 32% of its wording is shared with /solutions/find-customers-for-b2b-saas, and the generic intent overlaps /solutions/find-customers-on-linkedin.
noindex./case-studies/intentsly: About 280 words of body copy. Every proof.md number is also on /case-studies and in the blog; Google crawled it and did not index it.

noindexPrefixes./buying-signals/: Twelve copies of one template: only the service name, five illustrative phrasings and five roles change. /buying-signals itself stays indexable.
